fact_text: Pakistan's FY2026-27 federal budget sets total outlays of about PKR 18.7 trillion, as presented in the budget discussion.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Who Benefits Most from Pakistan's Budget 2026-27? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-13)

fact_text: The FY27 total revenue target is PKR 15.26 trillion, about 17.6% above the roughly PKR 13 trillion collected in FY26.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Who Benefits Most from Pakistan's Budget 2026-27? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-13)

fact_text: The FY27 total revenue target is about 17.6% above the FY26 collection of about PKR 13 trillion.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Who Benefits Most from Pakistan's Budget 2026-27? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-13)

fact_text: The FY27 federal development budget (PSDP) allocation is about PKR 1,000 billion, or PKR 1 trillion.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Who Benefits Most from Pakistan's Budget 2026-27? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-13)

fact_text: The FY27 budget sets a real GDP growth target of 4%.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Who Benefits Most from Pakistan's Budget 2026-27? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-13)

fact_text: An analyst said the 4% GDP target was reverse-engineered from weighted sector projections rather than set from a policy path.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Who Benefits Most from Pakistan's Budget 2026-27? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-13)

fact_text: The FY27 budget targets a primary surplus of 2% of GDP.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Who Benefits Most from Pakistan's Budget 2026-27? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-13)

fact_text: The FY27 overall budget deficit target is 3.6% of GDP, with a federal deficit target of 4.9% and provinces expected to contribute a large share of the overall surplus.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Who Benefits Most from Pakistan's Budget 2026-27? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-13)

fact_text: The FY27 export target is about USD 32 billion, down from USD 35 billion in FY26.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Who Benefits Most from Pakistan's Budget 2026-27? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-13)

fact_text: Public debt-to-GDP was reported to have fallen from about 75-76% to about 67-68% over three to four years, a figure the finance minister has cited.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Who Benefits Most from Pakistan's Budget 2026-27? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-13)

fact_text: Interest payments take about PKR 8 trillion a year of the budget, against a federal PSDP of about PKR 1 trillion.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Who Benefits Most from Pakistan's Budget 2026-27? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-13)

fact_text: The FBR tax-to-GDP ratio is about 10.6% in FY26, while the IMF programme committed to lifting it toward 13% by the end of the programme.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Who Benefits Most from Pakistan's Budget 2026-27? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-13)

fact_text: The IMF programme committed Pakistan to raising its tax-to-GDP ratio toward 13% by the end of the programme, which the analyst said was missed.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Who Benefits Most from Pakistan's Budget 2026-27? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-13)

fact_text: A non-filer faces withholding tax of 22% on the same purchase where a filer pays 11%.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Who Benefits Most from Pakistan's Budget 2026-27? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-13)

fact_text: About 95.5% of tax collected in Pakistan is paid by taxpayers through deductions and their own payments, with about 4.5% from FBR recovery drives, the analyst said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Who Benefits Most from Pakistan's Budget 2026-27? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-13)

fact_text: Pakistan has about 100 million (10 crore) bank accounts but only about 6 million taxpayers, which the analyst said points to a large untaxed base.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Who Benefits Most from Pakistan's Budget 2026-27? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-13)

fact_text: The cash economy is cited at about PKR 12 trillion, and the analyst said it is a main pain point of the economy.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Who Benefits Most from Pakistan's Budget 2026-27? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-13)

fact_text: The FY27 budget introduces a fixed tax scheme for retailers at about 1% of turnover, aimed at retailers with annual turnover up to about 200 million.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Who Benefits Most from Pakistan's Budget 2026-27? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-13)

fact_text: Sales tax digital invoicing is to be fully enforced from 1 July 2026, having earlier been scheduled for September.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Who Benefits Most from Pakistan's Budget 2026-27? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-13)

fact_text: The FBR is reportedly hiring third-party advisers on contract to check taxpayers' lifestyles, alongside faceless audits and digital tools.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Who Benefits Most from Pakistan's Budget 2026-27? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-13)

fact_text: Social media creators earning from Instagram, YouTube and other digital content are brought into the tax net in FY27, and vape liquids are taxed too.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Who Benefits Most from Pakistan's Budget 2026-27? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-13)

fact_text: A higher petroleum levy is expected to lift petrol from about PKR 130 to about PKR 135 per litre, according to the analyst's estimate.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Who Benefits Most from Pakistan's Budget 2026-27? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-13)

fact_text: The FY27 budget adds further items to the sales tax Third Schedule, which the analyst said passes costs directly onto end consumers.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Who Benefits Most from Pakistan's Budget 2026-27? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-13)

fact_text: The FY27 budget was delayed by about one week over a political settlement with the provinces, the analyst said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Who Benefits Most from Pakistan's Budget 2026-27? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-13)

fact_text: Salaried individuals got income-tax relief in FY27, and the analyst estimated a salaried earner at about PKR 1 lakh a month pays about PKR 6,000 less tax.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Who Benefits Most from Pakistan's Budget 2026-27? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-13)

fact_text: The super tax on individuals is withdrawn in FY27, a relief the analyst said had been overdue.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Who Benefits Most from Pakistan's Budget 2026-27? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-13)

fact_text: The super tax on companies is reduced from 10% to 8% in FY27.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Who Benefits Most from Pakistan's Budget 2026-27? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-13)

fact_text: Non-salaried earners such as professionals, clinic owners and small partnerships still face a top rate of 49.5% and got no relief in FY27, the analyst said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Who Benefits Most from Pakistan's Budget 2026-27? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-13)

fact_text: For a non-salaried earner, of every PKR 100 earned about PKR 42-43 goes to income tax, then 2% WWF and 5% WPPF, so roughly half is gone.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Who Benefits Most from Pakistan's Budget 2026-27? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-13)

fact_text: Withholding tax on foreign-currency transactions is cut from 5% to 0.5% in FY27.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Who Benefits Most from Pakistan's Budget 2026-27? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-13)

fact_text: The minimum tax for exporters is reduced to a combined 1.25%, from a previous rate of 1% plus 1%.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Who Benefits Most from Pakistan's Budget 2026-27? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-13)

fact_text: The minimum-tax turnover threshold rises from PKR 100 million to PKR 200 million, and the super tax on exporters is removed by a cabinet decision.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Who Benefits Most from Pakistan's Budget 2026-27? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-13)

fact_text: The reduced concessionary tax rate for IT exporters, due to expire, is extended to 2029.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Who Benefits Most from Pakistan's Budget 2026-27? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-13)

fact_text: Businesses get a tax credit of up to 10% of cost for hardware and software spent on invoicing infrastructure.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Who Benefits Most from Pakistan's Budget 2026-27? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-13)

fact_text: Remittances rose from about USD 1 billion in 2001 to about USD 40 billion in the figure cited for 2026, far faster than exports.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Who Benefits Most from Pakistan's Budget 2026-27? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-13)

fact_text: The analyst said export growth has been only about 2%, far behind the growth in remittances.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Who Benefits Most from Pakistan's Budget 2026-27? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-13)

fact_text: The PKR has been stable against the USD since March 2023, about three and a half years, the analyst noted.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Who Benefits Most from Pakistan's Budget 2026-27? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-13)

fact_text: The analyst said peers such as India, Vietnam, Thailand, South Korea, Turkey and Egypt let their currencies loosen after oil price rises to gain competitiveness, while Pakistan avoided that over inflation fears.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Who Benefits Most from Pakistan's Budget 2026-27? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-13)

fact_text: A global oil price crisis and regional geopolitical tension shape policy priorities, with policymakers focused on energy availability and price affordability, the analyst said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Who Benefits Most from Pakistan's Budget 2026-27? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-13)

fact_text: The economic survey cited in the discussion shows industry growth fell below 2%, which the analyst read as a rise in unemployment.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Who Benefits Most from Pakistan's Budget 2026-27? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-13)

fact_text: The analyst said Pakistan needs about 6% GDP growth to reach developing-economy status, so the 4-5% target falls short.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Who Benefits Most from Pakistan's Budget 2026-27? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-13)

fact_text: Revenue growth of 17.6% compares with about 8.2% inflation and 4% GDP growth, leaving about 5.6% to come from new measures and concessions.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Who Benefits Most from Pakistan's Budget 2026-27? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-13)

fact_text: The analyst put the revenue from new measures and concessions at about PKR 600 billion, and asked how that would be collected.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Who Benefits Most from Pakistan's Budget 2026-27? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-13)

fact_text: Pakistan's revenue targets have been ambitious for 10 to 15 years, the analyst said, and the FY27 target was not reset to realistic levels.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Who Benefits Most from Pakistan's Budget 2026-27? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-13)

fact_text: The analyst said the tax target is achievable only if the non-filer problem is tackled, and the budget keeps non-filer status as a legal category.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Who Benefits Most from Pakistan's Budget 2026-27? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-13)

fact_text: The analyst said consolidating existing FBR and sales-tax data with AI could bring about 10 million prospective taxpayers into the system.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Who Benefits Most from Pakistan's Budget 2026-27? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-13)

fact_text: The analyst argued that tax decisions set once a year are too slow, and that tax policy should be reviewed every month as conditions change.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Who Benefits Most from Pakistan's Budget 2026-27? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-13)

fact_text: Cash circulates because tax rates are high, the analyst said, since holders keep cash and earn about 10% on bank deposits rather than enter the formal system.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Who Benefits Most from Pakistan's Budget 2026-27? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-13)

fact_text: The analyst suggested demonetising PKR 5,000 notes as a way to document the economy.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Who Benefits Most from Pakistan's Budget 2026-27? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-13)

fact_text: The FY27 budget abolishes the Capital Value Tax (CVT), which applied to residents' foreign-held assets after a stay of more than 183 days in Pakistan.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Who Benefits Most from Pakistan's Budget 2026-27? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-13)

fact_text: Returning overseas residents get a two-year exemption from tax on their foreign income, the analyst said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Who Benefits Most from Pakistan's Budget 2026-27? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-13)

fact_text: The analyst said the CVT was regressive from the start and pushed people and capital out of Pakistan, so its abolition may bring back returning residents and foreign-asset declarations.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Who Benefits Most from Pakistan's Budget 2026-27? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-13)

fact_text: Corporate tax was reportedly cut by 1 percentage point a year from 35% to 29%, and the planned move to 25% did not happen.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Who Benefits Most from Pakistan's Budget 2026-27? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-13)

fact_text: The super tax relief does not reach oil and gas, power and fertiliser, which the analyst said together make up about 50-60% of index weight.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Who Benefits Most from Pakistan's Budget 2026-27? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-13)

fact_text: The FY27 super tax relief also excludes banks, which the analyst described as defensive and weakly tied to GDP growth.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Who Benefits Most from Pakistan's Budget 2026-27? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-13)

fact_text: Oil and gas earnings are tied to international oil prices, so domestic budget changes do little for them, the analyst said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Who Benefits Most from Pakistan's Budget 2026-27? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-13)

fact_text: Fertiliser demand is stagnant and depends on farm output, so the analyst saw no positive stock-market signal from the budget for fertiliser makers.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Who Benefits Most from Pakistan's Budget 2026-27? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-13)

fact_text: Cyclical sectors such as textiles, exporters and IT are more sensitive to the budget's tax relief than defensive sectors, the analyst said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Who Benefits Most from Pakistan's Budget 2026-27? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-13)

fact_text: Cement is a cyclical sector expected to benefit from the budget's property and construction measures, the analyst said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Who Benefits Most from Pakistan's Budget 2026-27? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-13)

fact_text: A tax applies to SUV-class cars of about 2000-3000 cc and to EVs valued above PKR 20 million in FY27.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Who Benefits Most from Pakistan's Budget 2026-27? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-13)

fact_text: Taxes on the sale and purchase of immovable property are reportedly halved in FY27.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Who Benefits Most from Pakistan's Budget 2026-27? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-13)

fact_text: Property prices rose as speculative money held in dollars, gold or abroad parked in property such as DHA Karachi, the analyst said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Who Benefits Most from Pakistan's Budget 2026-27? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-13)

fact_text: The analyst suggested a higher marginal tax on each additional property bought, so that a holder of many plots, such as PKR 15 crore, is discouraged from buying more.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Who Benefits Most from Pakistan's Budget 2026-27? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-13)

fact_text: The analyst said salary-tax relief returns to the economy as consumption of goods, services, travel, homes and cars rather than as savings.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Who Benefits Most from Pakistan's Budget 2026-27? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-13)

fact_text: The IMF had asked for agricultural income to be taxed, but provincial assemblies reportedly removed that measure in the past.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Who Benefits Most from Pakistan's Budget 2026-27? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-13)

fact_text: The analyst said the FY27 budget lacks big-ticket projects such as petrochemical plants, smelters, dams and railways, which take years to build.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Who Benefits Most from Pakistan's Budget 2026-27? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-13)

fact_text: The analyst said budget outcomes should be checked against monthly data, and the stock market may react positively from the Monday after the budget if the State Bank keeps interest rates steady.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Who Benefits Most from Pakistan's Budget 2026-27? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-13)

fact_text: The FY27 budget reportedly places a cap on National Finance Commission (NFC) transfers to the provinces.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Who Benefits Most from Pakistan's Budget 2026-27? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-13)

fact_text: The analyst said the federal government sees NFC distribution as a long-standing pain point and should widen the tax base rather than retain revenue.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Who Benefits Most from Pakistan's Budget 2026-27? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-13)

fact_text: The analyst said pension spending is rising faster than development spending and needs reform to stop the leakage.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Who Benefits Most from Pakistan's Budget 2026-27? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-13)

fact_text: The analyst said higher petroleum levy and sales tax items push the burden onto consumers and lower the chance of broadening the direct tax base.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Who Benefits Most from Pakistan's Budget 2026-27? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-13)

fact_text: The analyst said the budget lacked an ambitious non-filer measure, and that no new AI-based department was created to handle disputes and independent case scrutiny.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Who Benefits Most from Pakistan's Budget 2026-27? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-13)
